name: Tan Wei Liang
bio: Tan Wei Liang's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the precision and meticulous nature of racing after attending a Formula 1 race in Singapore. He transitioned from automotive manufacturing to racing quality control, bringing his rigorous approach to MP Motorsport Junior. Tan believes a proactive approach to quality, identifying potential issues before they become critical, is essential for consistent performance. His ability to see the 'big picture' allows him to anticipate problems and implement solutions effectively, making him an invaluable asset to the team, particularly in ensuring the reliability and safety of the junior drivers' equipment.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Tan is of average height with a slightly stocky build, giving him a grounded presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting observations.
Insists on performing a final visual inspection of every component before it's installed.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
